messages:
Priya (Product): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands sec section. Customers asked for a short, shareable summary on BYOK rotation guarantees, HSM support for Private, DSAR ownership, and ISO evidence timelines. Can we capture answers here?
Leah (Head of Security): Short answers: BYOK = supported for Private & Dedicated. Recommended rotation 90 days; we won't enforce automatic rewrap. Managed rotation is an opt-in add-on.
Anya (Compliance): Evidence needs: key rotation logs, access trails, and version history. We'll expose CSV exports in Console for SOC2/ISO evidence.
Kai (Eng-Infra): HSMs: supported via KMIP connector agent for on-prem HSMs. GA dependent on 2 pilot integrations and security certs.
Priya (Product): ETA for HSM GA?
Leah (Head of Security): Target end of Q3, subject to pilot outcomes.
Sam (Privacy): DSARs: Hosted API retains request metadata by default; payloads are ephemeral unless customer opts in. Private/Dedicated customers own DSAR responses for data in their environment; Redwood will provide metadata export tooling and timeboxed assistance per contract.
Priya (Product): Immutable replicas for audit logs?
Kai (Eng-Infra): We can replicate logs to customer buckets (S3/GCS) with versioning. WORM depends on storage provider; we'll publish configuration recipes.
Priya (Product): Action items?
Leah (Head of Security): Leah -> write BYOK FAQ + one-paragraph DSAR ownership policy.
Kai (Eng-Infra): Kai -> publish HSM pilot checklist + signup.
Anya (Compliance): Anya -> publish ISO evidence timeline and example exports.
ops-bot: Created SEC-799 "BYOK FAQ + DSAR policy" and SEC-800 "HSM pilot checklist".
Priya (Product): Thanks all. I'll assemble a customer-facing FAQ once drafts are up.
Leah (Head of Security): Closing loop. For NDA-level details route through Legal.
